_about: Compositions: named sequences of entries. An entry is an element name, a sub-composition name, or either followed by ' x N'; 'say: text' is an annotation shown and read aloud before the next entry; an entry in parentheses, like '(recapture underarm pass)', is quiet: danced but not announced, and not a stop for the swipes. Sub-compositions (made of elements) are used inside compositions by name; the composer picks each element's starting condition from the previous element's end.

compositions.name: 5 minutes exercise
compositions.notes: Daily exercise (user 2026-10-19): no circle, RTT only as a warm-up and never announced. The quiet entries bridge the states the chain needs: the cutoff starts side by side, so a recapture precedes each cutoff block; the lead underarm pass starts face to face, so one follower underarm pass precedes the second block of lead passes. 582 beats: 4:03 on Hot Swing (144), 4:35 on Sunday Reflection (127), 4:44 on Slow Your Roll (123).

sub_compositions.name: RTT
sub_compositions.notes: Rock step, triple step, triple step: the six-count basic (user 2026-10-18). Works from side and from facing.

sub_compositions.name: follower pass & back
sub_compositions.notes: Follower underarm pass out to face to face and the recapture back to side by side (the user's name, 2026-10-19).
